answer: A proof-of-space mechanism restricts Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock disk capacity via a verification bridge. Nodes prove persistent data retention across the network tundra by answering random audit queries. To forge identities, an attacker must acquire scarce non-volatile physical storage per agent. The system tracks the response latency plume to thwart emulation. However, it disproportionately empowers wealthy entities possessing vast surplus drive arrays.
